title: Pyrithione Zinc for Hair Loss and Dandruff: What the Research Shows

seo_description: What a 200-man trial found about 1% pyrithione zinc shampoo and hair count, what the dandruff research shows, and the allergy caution.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.
Old post (0 study links) made unsourced claims. Removed; rewritten around the one hair trial and the dandruff meta-analysis.
flags: The closing FullyVital product box (unchanged, sitewide) says products 'Promote Hair Regrowth'. Left for you, as with boron.
